name: MonarchAiToolCall
title: AiToolCall
wrapsNative: DisclosureGroup(isExpanded:content:label:) with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch), MonarchStatusBadge for the state and MonarchAiCodeBlock for the input and output
summary: One tool call of an assistant turn as a card that opens: what was done in plain words, the state as an icon and a word, how long it took and, on demand, the exact input and output.
whenToUse: For each tool-call part of an assistant message, when people should see what the assistant did; and in audit or debugging views where the raw arguments and results must be inspectable.
whenNotToUse: Not while the call waits for a decision: show an approval (MonarchAiPermissionScope or the app's approval card) instead. Not to show the result as a thing, such as a created record, which is MonarchAiToolResultCard.
api: init(_ part: MonarchAiToolCallPart, summary: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, toolLabels: [String: String] = [:], isExpanded: Binding<Bool>? = nil, announcesChanges: Bool = true, maxValueLength: Int = 4000, labels: MonarchAiToolCallLabels = MonarchAiToolCallLabels(), describeTool: (@MainActor (MonarchAiToolCallPart) -> String?)? = nil)

options.name: part
options.description: The call from the conversation model: name, input, state, output, error, start and end times, streamed input text.

options.name: summary
options.description: The one-line summary in words. Wins over describeTool.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the wrench symbol before the title. Decorative.

options.name: toolLabels
options.description: Display names by tool name. Unlisted tools get a humanized name.

options.name: isExpanded
options.description: Whether the details are open. Kept inside, closed at first, when nil.

options.name: announcesChanges
options.description: Whether a change of state is announced. Turn it off when the thread already announces it.

options.name: maxValueLength
options.description: The longest input or output shown before Show all, in characters. 0 shows everything.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the state names, the duration format, the headings, the empty and truncation notes, the announcement and Show all.

options.name: describeTool
options.description: Builds the summary from the call. Return nil to fall back to the tool's label.

states.name: pending approval
states.description: Warning tone, a triangle and "Waiting for approval".

states.name: awaiting result
states.description: Neutral tone, a clock and "Waiting for result".

states.name: running
states.description: Info tone, circling arrows and "Running". No duration until it ends.

states.name: succeeded
states.description: Success tone, a check mark, "Done" and the duration.

states.name: failed
states.description: Danger tone, an octagon, "Failed", and the error under the card without opening it.

states.name: denied
states.description: Neutral tone, a crossed circle and "Denied".

states.name: expanded
states.description: The tool's name, the input and the output in code blocks, or "No details yet.".

states.name: truncated
states.description: A value longer than maxValueLength is cut at a line end with "Showing 4,000 of 52,113 characters" and a Show all button.

appearance: A card on the subtle background with the subtle border; the tool icon uses the AI tool role, the state is a small status badge in its tone, the duration and notes are muted text and the error is the strong danger role. Every colour is a theme role, so it follows light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web uses <details>/<summary>; iOS uses the standard DisclosureGroup in the Monarch style, so the header is a button with an expanded or collapsed value. The running state shows a symbol instead of the web's spinner. Values are MonarchAiJSON, pretty-printed with sorted keys; the web keeps the key order of the object. The web renders input and output only while open; SwiftUI also builds the content only when the group is open. The summary is a String, not arbitrary content.
accessibility: The summary row is one button read as the title, the state and the duration, with the value Expanded or Collapsed.
State icons are decorative; the state is always a word as well as a tone.
A change of state after the card appears is announced as "<tool>: <state>"; the first state is not announced, and announcesChanges turns announcements off.
The error line is read as "Error: message".
The input and output blocks are named Input and Output through MonarchAiCodeBlock, with a Copy button.
The header and Show all are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: A call without input and output shows "No details yet." when open.
While arguments stream, inputText stands in for an empty input.
A string that holds JSON is re-indented; text that only starts with a brace is shown as it is.
Times that cannot be read, or an end before the start, show no duration.
A long title wraps; the state badge and duration move under it.

examples.title: Humanized summary with details
examples.template:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    MonarchAiToolCallPart(
        id: {{id}},
        name: {{name}},
        input: .string(#"{"query": "{{input.query|raw}}", "limit": {{input.limit}}}"#),
        state: {{state|case}},
        output: .string(#"{"results": [{"title": "{{output.results.0.title|raw}}", "id": "{{output.results.0.id|raw}}"}], "total": {{output.total}}}"#),
        startedAt: {{startedAt}},
        endedAt: {{endedAt}}
    ),
    summary: {{summary}},
    isExpanded: $open
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    MonarchAiToolCallPart(
        id: "call-1",
        name: "search_documents",
        input: .string(#"{"query": "Q3 plan", "limit": 5}"#),
        state: .succeeded,
        output: .string(#"{"results": [{"title": "Q3 planning notes", "id": "doc-18"}], "total": 1}"#),
        startedAt: "2026-03-02T10:00:00.000Z",
        endedAt: "2026-03-02T10:00:01.400Z"
    ),
    summary: "Searched documents for “Q3 plan”",
    isExpanded: $open
)

examples.title: A failed call, open
examples.code:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    MonarchAiToolCallPart(id: "call-2", name: "send_email", input: ["to": "ada@example.com"], state: .failed, error: "The mail server refused the message."),
    toolLabels: ["send_email": "Send an email"],
    isExpanded: $isExpanded
)
